info.title: Fuzzzy Law — Georgian law sources
info.description: Exact texts of Georgian laws with official matsne.gov.ge links and version dates, their earlier wordings, and published court decisions. Sources only: legal information, not legal advice.

get.description: Codes with article counts, official links and version dates.

Matching articles with exact snippet, link and version date.

found=false means nothing matched.
